a260924p1.summary: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 as a substantial chipset for upcoming audio devices, with a massive focus on better AI performance for audio wearables.
a260924p1.title: Qualcomm announces the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 for audio wearables, with up to 2x greater on-device AI performance and up to 40% lower power consumption (Andrew Romero/9to5Google)

a260924p10.summary: Once Claude can measure something, it can make it faster. So we kept finding more things to measure. Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.
a260924p10.title: Anthropic says it made Claude.ai and the Claude desktop app's core UX ~3x faster in August using an internal model to ship improvements "in a two-week sprint" (Anthropic)

a260924p11.summary: Australian data centre operator Firmus expects to lose $77 million in the current half, according to two people familiar …
a260924p11.title: Sources citing Firmus' IPO draft prospectus: the Australian data center operator expects to report a $77M loss after tax for H1 FY27 as it prepares to raise $5B (Christine Chen/Reuters)

a260924p12.summary: DeepSeek's annualized revenue run rate has hit $1 billion, more than double from less than $500 million a few months ago …
a260924p12.title: Sources: DeepSeek's annualized revenue run rate hits $1B, up from less than $500M a few months ago, as it aims to finalize a ~$7.5B fundraise by late October (The Information)

a260924p13.summary: Data-center spending is greater than that for the canals, railroads and grid combined—creating jobs and wealth but also boosting inflation
a260924p13.title: Brookings projects US AI spending to total $10.3T between 2025 and 2032, averaging 3.6% of GDP per year, the largest single-industry build-out as a share of GDP (Wall Street Journal)

a260924p14.summary: ‘Teflon’ Niklas Östberg to guide German food delivery group through asset sales and a new future under its US rival
a260924p14.title: Delivery Hero co-founder and CEO Niklas Östberg reverses his decision to step down in 2027, as the company prepares for Uber's €13B takeover and an asset sale (Financial Times)

a260924p15.summary: An island meeting, texts between the leaders of Canada, France and Norway reveal an emerging alliance: 'We're in'
a260924p15.title: Mark Carney, Emmanuel Macron, and other Western leaders are pushing to establish a global supervisory regime and "technology stability" body to govern AI (Wall Street Journal)

a260924p16.summary: In each incident, the technology appeared to be conducting mundane data collection and resorted to hacking techniques to get it, researchers said.
a260924p16.title: OpenAI says its AI agents "took actions we did not intend" when they tried to hack government and university websites, and it is working with the organizations (New York Times)

a260924p17.summary: New services allow employers to pinpoint who is being paid too much or too little — A lot of us worry artificial intelligence …
a260924p17.title: Companies are increasingly using AI benchmarking services to aggregate public job listings and other payroll data to identify under- and over-paid employees (Callum Borchers/Wall Street Journal)

a260924p18.summary: Brahma AI, an Indian start-up that makes artificial intelligence-generated audiovisual content for enterprise customers …
a260924p18.title: VFX company DNEG's AI unit Brahma, whose customers include Warner Bros. and the NBA, raised $150M led by Indian PE firm Multiples at a $2B post-money valuation (Priyanka Salve/CNBC)

a260924p19.summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd. launched a standalone payment app for foreign visitors to China, stepping up competition against rival Ant Group Co.
a260924p19.title: Tencent launches TenPayGo, a payment app for foreign visitors to China that lets them pay tens of millions of merchants via Visa, Mastercard, and Apple Pay (Bloomberg)

a260924p2.summary: Two startups that provide platforms to help businesses run artificial intelligence models are in funding talks to double their valuations …
a260924p2.title: Sources: Modal Labs is in funding talks at a ~$15B valuation, up from $4.65B in May; Baseten is in funding talks at a $26B valuation, up from $13B in June (Bloomberg)

a260924p20.summary: US e-commerce retailer Amazon (AMZN.O) will invest $3 billion to expand its India quick commerce business by 2030, two sources said …
a260924p20.title: Sources: Amazon plans to invest $1B into its Indian quick commerce operations by the end of 2027, and another $2B by 2030, as it battles local rivals (Reuters)

a260924p21.summary: Clash over proposed DHS rule to charge $103,265 fee reignites spat over highly skilled immigration
a260924p21.title: Industry group TechNet files a comment with the US DHS urging the White House to withdraw its proposal to charge $103,265 for most new H-1B visa applications (Wall Street Journal)

a260924p22.summary: The scramble to secure businesses against swarms of rogue artificial intelligence agents is fueling demand for new security tools.
a260924p22.title: Dallas-based enterprise browser security startup Island raised $400M led by Evolution Equity Partners at a $6.4B valuation and plans to grow its staff to 1,500 (Samantha Subin/CNBC)

a260924p3.summary: Jack Cable*,2, Daniel Chiu*, Francisco Pernice*,3, Selena Zhang*,1, James Anthony1, Tetiana Bas4, Gary Shen4, Conrad Stosz1, Jacob Steinhardt1
a260924p3.title: AI agents, including those from OpenAI, attempted to hack UNM's digital library, Data USA, and the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare in May and June (Transluce)

a260924p4.summary: Schneider Electric SE is nearing an agreement to acquire Shelly Group SE, a maker of smart devices for the home, according to people familiar with the matter.
a260924p4.title: Sources: Schneider Electric is nearing a deal to acquire Bulgaria-based smart home device maker Shelly Group at a €1.27B valuation, excluding debt (Bloomberg)

a260924p8.summary: Revolut Ltd. is piloting a new point-of-sale system in the UK that will let customers make in-store payments using their faces, as it pushes to bank more businesses.
a260924p8.title: Revolut is piloting a new POS system that uses facial recognition for payments at the UK coffee chain Kiss the Hippo, ahead of a full launch later in 2026 (Charlie Wells/Bloomberg)

a260924p9.summary: SHANGHAI — Earnings at Chinese chipmakers have grown more than 600% during the first half, buoyed by the artificial intelligence boom …
a260924p9.title: Analysis: total net profit at ~190 chipmakers listed in mainland China rose 620% YoY in H1 2026, driven by the AI boom and China's self-sufficiency campaign (Tomoko Wakasugi/Nikkei Asia)
